Source-assisted reading (research reader), made on the native images after the image-only first reading stams4-2026-10-31-image-only, with Munich, BSB, Clm 2941 (hand 1) and the Paris 1510 print of Rampegolus, Figurae Bibliae (hand 2) in hand; not blind. Reread on the image: 81_1r col. B (lower) and col. C (upper), 81_1v col. B, 81_2v col. B (upper), and two bands of 81_9v. 81_9r rests on the first reading. Lines read by the independent checker (81_2r col. B, 81_10r) are given in the report, not here. Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-31t6/Stams_STA_Frg_081_01r06r.jpg (canvas 0), ..._01v06v.jpg (canvas 1), ..._09r11r.jpg (canvas 4), ..._09v11v.jpg (canvas 5). Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels. Expansions in ( ), uncertain readings ?, lost or unread [..] or ..., line breaks /.

HAND 1

A. 81_1r col. B, canvas 0, 5250,1650,900,830
... in hoc pass(us) ... in loco passus est et ibi sua de/risio et verecundia maior esset. ¶ Sed q(ua)re voluit extra portam / crucifigi. dico q(uod) voluit io(?) ut ve/ritas corresponderet figure. q(uia) p(re)ceptu(m) / fuit in lege. q(uod) hostie que offe/rebant(ur) p(ro) p(e)cc(at)is deberent cremari / extra portam templi. sed x(ristu)s / qui fuit vera hostia p(ro) p(e)cc(at)is / n(ost)ris etia(m) ante portam voluit / [crucifigi]

fidel(is) toti domui sue sic [x(ristu)s] / vniuerso mundo. Unde d(icitu)r / Amplioris eni(m) glorie iste p[re moyse dig]/n(us) habitus est. ¶ No(ta) q(uod) [x(ristu)s fuit 33] / annor(um) et q(ua)si(?) ... / in pasca. Et [q(ua)re vo]luit in tali / etate mori. Dico [q(uod) hoc] vol[uit] / p(ro)pt(er) plura. ¶ P(ri)mo [voluit] mo[ri in tali] / etate iuuenili. vt in hoc [magis?] / sua(m) caritatem ostend(er)et q(uod) [p(ro) nobis] / in p(er)fectissima statu etate / cu(m) optimo moreret(ur). ¶ 2o vo[luit in tali] / etate mori et hoc ...

¶ Alij dicu(n)t q(uod) mili/tes p(re)parauer(un)t acetu(m) vt da/rent x(rist)o bibe(re) vt cito moreret(ur) / et ab eo soluerent(ur). quia dic(un)t / n(atur)ales q(uod) acetu(m) datu(m) crucifix(is) / acc(e)l(e)ra(n)di(?) cito morte(m). ¶ Sed / dicit d(omi)n(u)s Albert(us) q(uod) illud s(i)t / falsum p(ri)mo eo d(icitu)r(?) ... / ... acetu(m) ad bibendu(m). / Sed q(uod)(?) de hoc sit q(uod) iudei / ip(s)i(?) potu(m) p(re)parauerunt vt no(n) / solu(m) ip(su)m extrinsec(us) tormentaret / sed etia(m) vt intimus anxiaret. et / ... ¶ Unde dederunt sibi vinu(m) / felle mixtu(m) q(uia) fel est in ac/(er)bu(m)?(?) et mirratu(m) q(uia) totalit(er) in/sipidu(m) et hoc sic p(re)parauer(un)t / vt etia(m) intimus crucifigeret(ur). / In M(athe)o d(icitu)r Et cu(m) gustasset no/luit bibe(re). [box] Et in M(ar)c(o) d(icitu)r q(uod) no/luit [accipere] ... Dico q(uod) / ... sed no(n) recepit ad bibendu(m) / ... ad gustandu(m) etc. / [display] Sequit(ur). In littera(?)

q(uod) x(ristu)s sanguinem sudauit. S(ed) dicit / Theolog(us)?/Theophil(us)? q(uod) hoc ab alijs tene/tur. Unde sicut(?) [ex] anxietate / sudauit sudore(m) n(atur)alem. Et iste su/dor augebat(ur) sanguine cu(m) p(er) poros / exiuit ita q(uod) gutte fuerunt sangui/nee etc. [box: Ber(nardus)] O maria cur filius / ... et non cessaret sudor ei(us) ... / ... sacra/tum etc. / [display] Sequit(ur).
